installCommand: npx pnpm@9 install --no-frozen-lockfile --filter @srb/api && rm -rf apps/api/node_modules/@srb/database apps/api/node_modules/@srb/shared && cp -r packages/database apps/api/node_modules/@srb/database && cp -r packages/shared apps/api/node_modules/@srb/shared
buildCommand: npx prisma generate --schema=packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && cd packages/database && npx tsc && cd ../shared && npx tsc
